AboutDescription:
My Golden Food Food Industry and Trade Inc. is a frozen food producer company established to serve in all parts of frozen food. The company's main brand name is Moonlife.

It has started the production packaging process with fruits. Some of the 350 gr bowl (plastic) packaging products from the Berry group have been activated and are being produced.

These products;

1- Strawberry
2- Blackberry
3- Raspberry
4- Blueberry
5- Cherry
6- 3 Mixed Forest Fruits (Raspberry Blackberry, Strawberry)
7- 4 Mixed forest fruits are (Red Currant, Blueberry, Raspberry, Blackberry)

2. Personal Data Processed

The personal data collected through this form includes: Company name, authorized person name, email address, phone number, city/region information, cold storage status, products of interest, and additional message/notes.

3. Purposes of Processing Personal Data

Your personal data is processed for the purposes of evaluating your regional dealership application, contacting you, managing the application process, fulfilling legal obligations, and conducting commercial activities.

4. Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data

Your personal data is processed based on the legal grounds specified in Articles 5 and 6 of the Turkish KVKK Law No. 6698, including "Explicit consent", "Being directly related to the establishment or performance of a contract", and "Fulfillment of the data controller's legal obligation".

5. Retention Period of Personal Data

Your personal data will be retained for the period required by the processing purposes and within the framework of legal retention periods. Upon expiration of this period, your data will be deleted, destroyed, or anonymized in accordance with KVKK and relevant legislation.

6. Transfer of Personal Data

Your personal data may be transferred to public institutions and organizations, suppliers, and business partners we work with, when necessary for the fulfillment of the purposes stated above and for the fulfillment of legal obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties except for legal obligations.

7. Your Rights Under KVKK

In accordance with Article 11 of KVKK, regarding your personal data, you have the right to:

  • Learn whether your personal data is being processed,
  • Request information if it has been processed,
  • Learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with its purpose,
  • Know the third parties to whom it has been transferred domestically or abroad,
  • Request correction if it has been processed incompletely or inaccurately,
  • Request deletion or destruction if the reasons requiring processing have ceased to exist,
  • Request notification of the above operations to third parties to whom it has been transferred,
  • Object to the emergence of a result against you by analyzing exclusively through automated systems,
  • Request compensation for damages if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.

8. Application Method

To exercise your rights stated above, you can send an email to info@mygoldenfood.com with documents identifying your identity, or apply in writing to our company address.
